prompt: In May 2025, what share of the products that any competitor checked did both competitors check? Use the competitor_prices table, where competitor is 'Bliksem' or 'Stroomhuis'. observed_ts holds the time of the check in UTC, so take May in UTC: from 2025-05-01 00:00 up to but not including 2025-06-01 00:00. Count each product once. Return three columns, in this order: products_both, the number of products both competitors checked, products_any, the number of products at least one of them checked, and both_pct, 100 times products_both divided by products_any, rounded to 1 decimal with ROUND(x, 1). Return one row. Any row order is fine.
hints: Next, combine the two one-row counts into one row and work out the percentage.
INTERSECT gives the products in both lists and UNION the products in either, each once. Each count is one row, so a CROSS JOIN puts them side by side; keep the decimals when you divide.
why_this_works: INTERSECT and UNION each keep a product once, so their counts are products, not checks, and 100.0 keeps the decimals of the share.
